description: This Java class 'KeyboardDimensFromTheme' implements the 'KeyboardDimens' interface and provides methods to get and set various keyboard dimension parameters such as width, key gaps, key heights, and padding, likely used for theming or layout purposes in a keyboard UI.

classes.name: KeyboardDimensFromTheme
classes.description: A class that implements KeyboardDimens interface to provide keyboard dimension values based on theme settings, with getter and setter methods for various dimension attributes.

methods.name: getKeyboardMaxWidth
methods.description: Returns the maximum width of the keyboard.

methods.name: getKeyHorizontalGap
methods.description: Returns the horizontal gap between keys.

methods.name: getRowVerticalGap
methods.description: Returns the vertical gap between rows.

methods.name: getNormalKeyHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of normal keys.

methods.name: getSmallKeyHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of small keys.

methods.name: getLargeKeyHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of large keys.

methods.name: getPaddingBottom
methods.description: Returns the bottom padding for the keyboard.

methods.name: setKeyboardMaxWidth
methods.description: Sets the maximum width of the keyboard.

methods.name: setHorizontalKeyGap
methods.description: Sets the horizontal gap between keys.

methods.name: setVerticalRowGap
methods.description: Sets the vertical gap between rows.

methods.name: setNormalKeyHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of normal keys.

methods.name: setLargeKeyHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of large keys.

methods.name: setSmallKeyHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of small keys.

methods.name: setPaddingBottom
methods.description: Sets the bottom padding for the keyboard.
